string.text: Anomalous Activity Scanner M1
Anomalous Activity Scanner M2

An improved stationary anomaly-field monitor. Install it inside a field, with one scanner per cluster. It operates without faults: the field's PDA marker turns green when a natural artifact is present, and a separate icon shows the artifact's actual position, even if it rolls outside the field. Once the artifact is collected, its icon disappears and the field's marker returns to its usual color. A black M2 badge on the field outline identifies the installed scanner. If the field already has M1, select Install on M2 in your inventory and confirm the replacement. The old device will be destroyed without returning components; there is no need to find it. No batteries or maintenance are required. A deployed scanner cannot be recovered. To destroy it, aim at the scanner and hold the use key for five seconds.

A stationary device monitors natural artifacts and reports to the anomaly field's existing PDA marker. Enter the field and select "Install" in your inventory. Only one scanner can be installed per field; isolated anomalies are unsuitable. 

%c[255,0,255,0]Green marker%c[default] — a natural artifact is present. Once it is collected, a working scanner restores the marker's usual color. 
%c[default]Usual color — no natural artifact is present. 
%c[255,188,138,53]Gold marker%c[default] — the device is malfunctioning: an artifact may or may not be present. Check the field in person. This signal lasts until the next emission, even if the artifact is collected. 

M1 is the basic model and can produce an unstable signal. M2 operates without faults and also displays a separate PDA icon at the natural artifact's actual position. The icon follows the artifact and disappears when it is collected. A black M1 or M2 badge on the lower-right edge of the field outline identifies the installed scanner, including when the field is empty. 

A deployed M1 can be replaced with M2: enter the same field, select Install on M2 in your inventory and confirm the warning. The old M1 will be destroyed without returning components; there is no need to find it.

Readings are updated after every emission. No batteries are required. An installed scanner cannot be recovered. To destroy it, get within 3 metres, aim at the device, hold the use key for 5 seconds and confirm.
